findings.title: Governor Jenniffer González-Colón and HHS Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. Inaugurate New Vieques Health Center, Restoring Essential Healthcare Services to the Island
findings.exact_supporting_passage: Today, Vieques once again has a healthcare facility worthy of its people.
findings.access_consequences: Restores on-island hospital-level access and reduces the need for residents to travel off-island before receiving initial care.

coverage_notes: CMS Public Notices was checked first; the newest listed notices were six hospice termination notices dated 2026-09-25.
Twelve additional targeted searches covered the bounded high-value miss classes.
One qualifying restoration was found in Vieques, Puerto Rico.
The source provides a publication date but no visible publication timestamp, so exact within-hour publication timing remains unverified.
Production collection remains authoritative; this run is supplementary only.
